Montreal Canadiens Extend Coach Martin St. Louis' Contract

The Montreal Canadiens have signed head coach Martin St. Louis to a multi-year contract extension. The terms of the deal were not immediately disclosed. St. Louis has been the head coach of the Canadiens since February 2022. The team has not provided further details on the extension.
